senses.gloss:
ind.
1 The mystic name of the deity, prefacing all the prayers and most of the writings of the Hindus.
E.
अ a name of VIṢṆU, उ ŚIVA, and म of BRAHMA; it therefore implies the Indian triad, and expresses the three in one.
2 A particle of command or injunction.
3 Of assent, (verily, amen.)
4 Of auspiciousness.
5 Of removal, (away, hence,) and,
6 It is an inceptive particle.
E.
अव to go, to preserve, &c. मन् Uṇādi affix, the radical being converted into ओ.
